component.name: Winebundle
component.summary: Install and play Windows games with Wine

description.p: Winebundle guides you through installing a Windows game on Linux. Each game gets its own Wine environment, so games can't break each other.

ul.li: Check that this computer has what Windows games need, with commands to fix anything missing
Install from a game installer, or add a game that's already installed
Test the game before saving it to your library
Add application menu and desktop shortcuts for each game
